medium.zh: 互動光影紮染・五味聯覺創作

caption.en: Five flavors—sour, sweet, bitter, spicy, and salty—translated into five hand-dyed cotton techniques: concentric shibori rings, billowy cloud mist, splashed sumi ink, irregular atomizer spray, and Jovian cloud-sea bands. Type any dish to weave its five-taste ratio automatically, or paint directly onto the cloth.
caption.zh: 將酸、甜、苦、辣、鹹五種味覺，一對一轉譯為五種棉布染繪技法：藍染同心圓（酸）、雲霧暈染（甜）、破墨潑墨（苦）、不規則點狀噴霧（辣）與木星雲海帶狀暈染（鹹）。輸入任意食物即可自動解析五味配方並即興染製，或親手切換五味筆觸在棉布上疊染。

alt.en: Five-taste shibori composition on archival white cotton cloth layering indigo concentric tie-dye rings, sky-blue and rose cloud mist, violet Jovian banded swirls, magenta mist spray, and splashed sumi ink
alt.zh: 五味紮染全幅棉布畫格：靛藍同心圓紮染、天藍與粉紅雲霧、紫色木星雲海氣流帶、洋紅點狀噴霧與濃墨飛濺交織於純白棉布之上
